_comment: Glass opacity presets (item_139): the ONE table for surface alpha. Read by Commons/Appearance.qml (panel/card fills), scripts/theme-switch.py (kitty background_opacity + mango focused/unfocused window opacity = winFocused/winUnfocused) and scripts/contrast-check.py --glass (text contrast over a mid-grey wallpaper at each preset). panel = frame/panel glass, panelAlt = its lighter twin + sheen stops, card = dashboard/settings cards. glass is the pre-item_139 look (light panels raised 0.92/0.90 -> 0.96/0.95 so text stays AA over a mid-grey wallpaper) and the default. Two presets by owner decision 2026-09-30 (a third, more transparent step was dropped; the base look was renamed soft -> glass 2026-10-01). kitty is opaque in mango (windowrule, dotfiles), so its own kitty value carries the whole look: 0.5/0.77 = the old 0.6/0.9 x mango's 0.85. Light panels cannot go below ~0.94 without dropping gruvbox-light text under AA over mid-grey; dark stops at ~0.82 (monochrome). A pack material flat/matte stays opaque whatever the preset. blur (item_116, adr_035): the compositor blurs what is behind the shell's surfaces (theme-switch writes mango blur_layer; off with a pack); dark glass panels went 0.96/0.93 -> 0.82/0.82 so the blur shows while bright wallpapers stay calm (owner, 2026-10-15); cards keep 0.58 and their 3D. Blur mode (appearance.glassBlur = windows) uses the SAME alphas as X-ray (owner, 2026-10-21: Blur must sit at X-ray's brightness and differ only in styling). It briefly had its own lower dark alphas (darkWindows 0.70, 2026-10-15); a lower alpha does not lift a blurred window, it lets more of it through, so panels read darker or lighter depending on the spot; with equal alphas the shell draws pixel-identical to X-ray wherever no window is behind (headless render check, 2026-10-21). Commons/Appearance.qml glassAlpha still honours a darkWindows/lightWindows entry if one is ever added. The patched scenefx (dotfiles packages/scenefx-coverage, coverage_full) gives a blurred surface the full blur only from alpha 0.70 up, below the lowest panel alpha here (0.82): a panel alpha under 0.70 needs that constant lowered too.

blurTunes._comment: Blur-mode compensation presets (owner picks, 2026-10-21). Only active with appearance.glassBlur = windows and appearance.blurTune set; the default none leaves Blur at X-ray's alphas and the mango blur brightness untouched. brightness = mango blur_params_brightness raised to `mangoBrightness` (theme-switch writes it and puts it back to `mangoBrightnessBase`, the dotfiles value, when the tune is dropped); tint = panel base colour lifted `lift` of the way toward surface2 (light themes: toward white); opacity = panel/panelAlt alphas raised to at least `panel`.
